models.name: shopping_mall_system_settings
models.description: Stores global system settings and configuration values for the shopping mall platform infrastructure. Holds configurable parameters impacting system behavior and administration.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique key identifier for the system setting.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value corresponding to the configuration key.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the setting's purpose and usage.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_platform_configs
models.description: Configuration parameters specific to the shopping mall platform instance, including feature flags, versioning, and environment settings.

plainFields.name: config_name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the configuration parameter.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Value of the configuration parameter.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the configuration usage.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_channel_definitions
models.description: Defines communication or operational channels within the shopping mall platform. Supports hierarchical channel groups via parent-child relationships.

foreignFields.name: parent_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent channel for hierarchical grouping. {@link shopping_mall_channel_definitions.id}.

plainFields.name: channel_code
plainFields.description: Unique code identifying the channel.

plainFields.name: channel_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the channel.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Descriptive text explaining the channel's purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time the channel was updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark channel as removed.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Customer accounts registered on the shopping mall platform. Customers can log in, manage personal profiles, shopping carts, orders, and reviews. Each customer has unique authentication credentials and related sessions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for customer login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Display name or nickname of the customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account is soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for shopping mall customers. Each session corresponds to a login instance for a customer acting in their security context.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Seller accounts registered on the shopping mall platform. Sellers manage their own product listings, inventory, orders, and storefront profiles.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for seller login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: store_name
plainFields.description: Name of the seller's store or business.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account is soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for shopping mall sellers. Each session corresponds to a seller's login instance with authentication context.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of seller session origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL of the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional session expiration timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Administrative user accounts who have full access to all platform features and management functions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for admin authentication.

plainFields.name: full_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the admin user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Admin account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for platform administrators. Records login instances and security data per admin user.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of admin session origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL of the session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the session.

models.name: shopping_mall_guests
models.description: Guest user session representations for unauthenticated visitors browsing the shopping mall catalog. Guests have limited access and no authentication sessions.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the guest session creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description: Product categories organized hierarchically with parent-child relationship supporting flexible nested categorization for products. Enforces unique category names within the same hierarchy level to ensure unambiguous navigation and filtering. Serves as the primary classification mechanism for products within the shopping mall platform.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category's {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}. Nullable for top-level categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name, unique among sibling categories to avoid conflicts.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and content.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Category creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Category last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the category.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Products listed within the shopping mall platform, each assigned to one or more categories. Represents core commerce entities with detailed attributes for descriptions, branding, and pricing. Maintains inventory and variant relationships through SKUs. Enables sellers and admins to manage product information independently.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business identifier code for the product.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name with descriptive title.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed textual description of the product.

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Brand or manufacturer name for the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Product creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Product last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the product.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_skus
models.description: Stock Keeping Units (SKU) representing distinct product variants defined by combinations of attributes such as color, size, and other options. Each SKU has a unique code and pricing information. Inventory tracking is performed externally via other components. Related to a single product and enables granular product management.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code identifying the variant globally.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price of this SKU variant.

plainFields.name: attributes_json
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded variant attributes such as color, size, and options.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: SKU creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: SKU last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the SKU.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_search_index
models.description: Materialized view optimized for full-text product and SKU search operations. Contains denormalized and precomputed search fields for efficient keyword and attribute-based querying. This table is read-only and updated by background processes to reflect current product catalog state.

plainFields.name: product_id
plainFields.description: Related product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_id
plainFields.description: Related SKU's {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}. Nullable if index entry relates only to product level.

plainFields.name: search_text
plainFields.description: Concatenated searchable text for full-text search.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Search index entry creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Search index entry last updated timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_carts
models.description: Shopping cart information associated with a customer and their session. This entity stores the overall cart state for the customer, allowing persistent shopping across sessions and devices. It references the owning customer and the current session and supports soft deletion and temporal tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Current customer session {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id} for cart tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Cart last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field to mark cart as deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description: Individual items contained in a customer's shopping cart. Each item references the shopping cart it belongs to, as well as the individual product SKU being purchased. This entity allows managing multiple SKUs within a single cart, including quantities and timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU of the product {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id} added to cart.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this SKU added to the cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Item addition timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Item last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field for cart items.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Wishlist belonging to a customer, representing a collection of product SKUs the customer is interested in purchasing later. It maintains session linkage and temporal tracking to allow persistent, user-specific wishlists.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Current customer session {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id} capturing wishlist activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp marking wishlist removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual product SKUs added by a customer to their wishlist. Each item references the wishlist it belongs to and the associated product SKU. It tracks quantity and timestamp info for accurate wishlist management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Product SKU included in wishlist {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of SKU units wished for.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when SKU was added to wishlist.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of wishlist item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field for wishlist items.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Customer orders placed on the shopping mall platform. Includes order lifecycle status, payment status, total amount, shipping address, and references to the owning customer. Supports soft deletion and timestamps for lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: order_code
plainFields.description: Unique order code used for business reference and lookup.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the order (e.g., pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Status of payment for this order (e.g., unpaid, paid, refunded).

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount payable for the order, accounting for all items and fees.

plainFields.name: shipping_address
plainFields.description: Full shipping address for order delivery.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last order update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the order was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Line items within a customer order, each linked to a specific product SKU. Contains quantity, unit price, and extended pricing for inventory tracking and order detail accuracy.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the SKU ordered.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at order time.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Extended price for this line item (quantity multiplied by unit price).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification to the order item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Logical deletion timestamp for the order item, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description: Payment records for orders, capturing payment method, status, amount, and timestamps for audit and reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this payment is associated with {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_method
plainFields.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit_card, bank_transfer).

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

plainFields.name: payment_amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid for the order.

plainFields.name: payment_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the payment was made.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last update of the payment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for logical deletion of the payment record.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_trackings
models.description: Shipment tracking information for orders, including tracking number, carrier, status, and timestamps for shipment lifecycle monitoring.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Related order for this shipment tracking {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-provided shipment tracking number.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier, e.g., UPS, FedEx.

plainFields.name: shipping_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the shipment (e.g., shipped, in_transit, delivered).

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Date and time the shipment was sent.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Date and time the shipment was delivered, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews
models.description: Customer product reviews capturing ratings and textual feedback, linked to products and customers, with moderation status and timestamps. Supports audit trails and versioning of review data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this review to verify purchase. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numeric rating from 1 to 5 representing customer satisfaction.

plainFields.name: review_body
plainFields.description: Optional textual comments provided by customer (max 1000 chars).

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Review moderation status such as 'pending', 'approved', or 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Review creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Review last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for logical removal (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_queues
models.description: Active moderation queue holding reviews and related content flagged for administrative review or automatic filtering. Enables tracking of review status, moderator actions, and notes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: Linked product review requiring moderation. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: flagged_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for review being flagged and sent to moderation.

plainFields.name: moderator_notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes added by moderators during review.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Moderation queue status such as 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', or 'needs_changes'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was queued for moderation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last moderation action update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to mark moderation queue rows as inactive.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profiles
models.description: Profiles for sellers containing business and contact information, supporting identity verification and profile management. Linked to shopping_mall_sellers for authentication and authorization.

plainFields.name: store_name
plainFields.description: Official store or business name of the seller.

plainFields.name: business_registration_number
plainFields.description: Government-issued business registration number for verification.

plainFields.name: contact_email
plainFields.description: Primary contact email for seller communications.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for seller support.

plainFields.name: profile_description
plainFields.description: Description or biography of the seller's store.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of profile creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last profile update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag indicating profile removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_inventories
models.description: Represents current inventory levels for each product SKU. Tracks available quantity, stock status, and last updated timestamps. References shopping_mall_product_skus to tie inventory data to specific variants. Maintains data integrity with non-nullable foreign keys and consistent temporal fields. Supports real-time inventory queries and stock availability checks.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current inventory quantity for this SKU. Cannot be negative.

plainFields.name: stock_status
plainFields.description: Inventory stock status, e.g., 'in stock', 'out of stock', 'backordered'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_stock_adjustments
models.description: Records all inventory stock adjustments for SKUs including additions, subtractions, reservations, and releases. Each adjustment logs the SKU affected, the quantity change, adjustment type, actor (customer, seller, admin) responsible, and timestamps for audit and operational integrity. Ensures that adjustments maintain accurate inventory states and provide complete history for reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Inventory adjustment related to product SKU {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: adjustment_type
plainFields.description: Type of adjustment: 'addition', 'subtraction', 'reservation', or 'release'.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity adjusted; positive integer for additions/reservations, negative for subtractions.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who made the adjustment: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: ID of the actor who performed adjustment. Reference depends on actor_type.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the adjustment was made.

models.name: shopping_mall_low_stock_alerts
models.description: Captures alerts generated when SKU inventory falls below configured low stock thresholds. Records the SKU involved, alert generation timestamp, resolution status, and notification details. Supports operational monitoring and proactive restocking workflows by sellers and administrators.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU for which the low stock alert was generated {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: alerted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the low stock alert was triggered.

plainFields.name: resolved
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the alert has been resolved.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved, null if unresolved.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_histories
models.description: Historical records capturing the full lifecycle and state changes of orders placed by customers on the shopping mall platform. Tracks all modifications over time, including status updates, payments, and shipment events for auditing and analysis purposes. References the primary {@link shopping_mall_orders.id} entity. Used for immutable audit trails and comprehensive order history queries.

plainFields.name: order_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the order at this historical snapshot (e.g., 'pending', 'shipped', 'cancelled').

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Status of payment at this snapshot (e.g., 'paid', 'pending', 'failed').

plainFields.name: shipment_status
plainFields.description: Shipment state of the order at this point in time.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total monetary amount for the order at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp capturing when this history record was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last update of this snapshot record.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellations
models.description: Records of customer-initiated order cancellations. Tracks cancellation requests, reasons, statuses, and timestamps related to orders. Each cancellation references the original order and the customer who requested it. Enables audit trail and processing workflows for order cancellations.

plainFields.name: cancellation_reason
plainFields.description: Text describing the customer's reason for cancellation.

plainFields.name: cancellation_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the cancellation process (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the cancellation record.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Tracks customer refund requests for orders. Contains refund amounts, reasons, statuses, and linked order and customer information. Used for managing refund workflows and auditing financial adjustments related to sales.

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Monetary amount requested for refund.

plainFields.name: refund_reason
plainFields.description: Text description of the refund reason provided by customer.

plainFields.name: refund_status
plainFields.description: Current processing status of the refund (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'declined').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for refund request record.

models.name: shopping_mall_return_shipments
models.description: Records of physical return shipments linked to refund requests. Tracks shipment tracking information, carrier details, return status, and timestamps. Associated with the refund request and customer. Supports return process monitoring and customer notifications.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier handling the return.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the return shipment.

plainFields.name: return_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the return shipment (e.g., 'requested', 'in_transit', 'received', 'inspected', 'completed').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return shipment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for return shipment record.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_activities
models.description: Records all actions performed by admin users on the platform for audit and tracking purposes. It logs what operation was performed, when, and by which admin user, aiding compliance and forensic analysis.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user performing the activity. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: activity
plainFields.description: Description of the admin activity performed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Activity timestamp when the action occurred.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last update to the activity record.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_approvals
models.description: Tracks the approval status of products submitted by sellers. Records which admin performed the approval, status updates, and timestamps for moderation tracking and compliance verification.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user who approved or rejected the product. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Approval status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for rejection or comments by the admin.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the approval record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last update to the approval record.

models.name: shopping_mall_user_roles
models.description: Manages user roles in the platform, detailing which user has what role (e.g., admin, customer, seller) with timestamps for audit and role change tracking.

plainFields.name: user_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the user the role is assigned to.

plainFields.name: role_name
plainFields.description: Name of the role granted to the user (e.g., admin, seller, customer).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was assigned.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last update to this role assignment.

models.name: shopping_mall_platform_audit_logs
models.description: Comprehensive audit logs for platform-wide actions and system events. Supports forensic analysis, security audits, and operational monitoring with detailed metadata and timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user related to this audit event, if available. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of the audit event, e.g., login, access, change.

plainFields.name: event_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit event was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_business_rules
models.description: Business rules enforcing platform-wide constraints, validation logic, and compliance checkpoints. Each rule has a unique code and descriptive metadata guiding system behavior and validation. Acts as a centralized source for business rule definitions and aids in automated enforcement.

plainFields.name: business_rule_code
plainFields.description: Unique business rule identifier code.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed textual explanation of the rule's intent, scope, and application context.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the rule is active and enforced by the system.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded additional data for rule parameters, conditions, or complex configurations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the business rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the business rule.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp marking the rule as inactive without removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_error_logs
models.description: Comprehensive error logs capturing operational errors, system faults, and exception traces occurring within the shoppingMall platform. Each log entry records error codes, messages, severity, context metadata, and timestamps for troubleshooting and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: System-specific code identifying the type of error encountered.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Detailed error message describing the issue encountered.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level of the error (e.g., INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

plainFields.name: context_metadata
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded metadata capturing environmental/contextual details relevant to the error.

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: shopping_mall_exception_events
